finiteOrNull.description: A finite measurement, or null when it was non-finite (e.g. NaN on a degenerate corpus). Bare NaN/Infinity are never emitted.

bytes_per_vector.description: null when the ratio is zero (infinite bytes/vector is not emitted).

pca_dim.description: PCA pre-reduction dimension, or null for whole-vector recipes.

description: The record emitted by `tqp plan embeddings` (turboquant_pro.cli._cmd_plan_embeddings). It states the chosen compression recipe for an embedding matrix under a byte-per-vector budget, the rank-certificate preview used as the acceptance signal (a distribution-free floor, NOT reconstruction cosine), the full candidate frontier, and any risk flags. `passed` is false when the budget cannot be met (the smallest recipe is still shown) or the certificate preview is vacuous. `certificate_preview` carries an `error` string instead of floors when the preview itself raised. schema_version 1.

alternatives.description: The full Pareto frontier of candidate recipes.

certificate_preview.description: Distribution-free rank-certificate preview (the acceptance signal), or an error record when the preview raised.

error.description: 'ExcType: message' from the preview; the plan must never crash on it.

max_bytes_per_vector.description: Byte budget per vector, or null when unconstrained.

path.description: Embeddings file the plan was built from.

shape.description: The (n, d) shape before any flattening.

note.description: Scope note: the acceptance signal is the rank-certificate preview; cosine is a labelled diagnostic.

passed.description: False when the budget cannot be met or the certificate preview is vacuous.

recommended.description: The chosen recipe: best eligible under the budget, or the smallest when the budget cannot be met.

reproduction.description: How to validate the plan with `tqp certify`.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change; additive fields do not bump it.

tool_version.description: turboquant-pro package version that produced the plan.

title: TurboQuant Pro embedding plan
